overview:
# Authenticated output integration — review only

The installed PR21 reader proves metadata only. This change adds schema2 output
verification: reviewed installed source workflow pins; actual private run/jobs;
GitHub artifact IDs, SHA256 and run/head/repository identity; one explicit storage
redirect with no GitHub bearer; exact bounded ZIP inventory; canonical unsigned
manifest and complete archive/tree; authenticated publisher receipt and Git commit;
encrypted handoff/publication hashes; downstream publication and byte matching.
No private bodies are printed or decrypted by the reader. Missing, stale, expired,
ambiguous, substituted, changed or inaccessible evidence fails closed. Artifacts
must be unexpired and less than one day old; plans expire within one hour.

Reader trust is the exact reviewed workflow SHA256 fetched at the actual run's
immutable public commit, with Git blob verification. This avoids a self-referential
full-controller-commit pin when later release workflows merge. Unknown reader or
source workflow pins remain hard failures. The old PR21 activation proposal is
preserved byte-for-byte; its metadata-only success cannot authorize consumption.

The same controller workflow has a separate schema3 credential-free unsigned
qualification authorization. Its exact reviewer comment is
`APPROVE_UNSIGNED_QUALIFICATION <digest> run:<id>`. The private source jobs check
actual completed protected approval, reviewed controller workflow bytes, exact
source workflow commit, release/config digest and deadline before proceeding.
Schema3 cannot serve as output attestation or authorize handoff/signing/upload.
Only verify-output mode maps the read-only PAT; authorization mode maps no secret.

The private publisher authenticates raw artifact ZIP bytes itself; it does not
rely on download-artifact's warning behavior. Fixed a literal-backslash-n upload
path defect. Publisher receipt and encrypted handoff artifacts have one-day
retention, no overwrite, no plaintext credentials or signed IPA. Private Git
objects persist; their retention needs explicit approval. No garbage-collection
or secure-deletion claim is made.

Disposable local upload journals are not replay authority. Actual GitHub workflow
history now freezes any second release attempt, including failure/cancel/timeout;
unsigned qualification also refuses a second attempt before candidate build.
Recovery requires a separately reviewed change and real state reconciliation;
there is no dispatch override, automatic retry or resume. Existing concurrency
remains fixed with cancellation disabled. This does not control privileged manual
history deletion or external Apple activity; those are outside pipeline authority.

## Exact minimum qualification proposals — NOT installed or authorized

1. `controller-source-output-authorizer-PROPOSED.yml` replaces only the fixed
   controller reader path, retaining public standard Ubuntu jobs, permissions{},
   main/operator/attempt restrictions and TestFlight-Approval independent gate.
   It removes only the two preparation stops and changes the label. Output mode
   remains unusable until reviewed source pins are installed; no PAT creation
   or use is authorized. The credential-free authorization mode is separately gated.
2. `source-unsigned-isolated-QUALIFICATION-PROPOSED.yml` is the actual separate
   macos-26 unsigned V4 builder and fresh Ubuntu publisher, using existing job
   credentials only (builder Contents/Actions:read; publisher Contents:write and
   Actions:read). It enables ONLY unsigned job helpers and pins proposal1's exact
   bytes. No Apple/feed/SSH secret is mapped. It produces private unsigned DATA
   and an authenticated receipt, never a signed IPA. This qualifies the changed
   build/publisher/transport path; existing APFS and native staging are reused.

Installation, ONE protected credential-free authorization and ONE private native
qualification remain separate owner operations after exact azodomain review,
immutable installed-source/workflow checks, branch/environment protection checks
and fresh included compute/storage headroom. Account-specific billing evidence is
retained privately and must be refreshed before any native dispatch approval.
No dispatch approval is requested yet. Bound standard job timeouts
are 35 minutes macOS +5 Ubuntu for source, and 1+3 public Ubuntu for authorization.

After actual qualification: independently review/install source-output pins and
reader file bytes; only then separately approve/provision the existing proposed
seven-day one-repository Actions:read (+mandatory Metadata:read) PAT via protected
secret entry, verify actual outputs, revoke/delete on completion/pause/failure.
Original encrypted credential handoff, protected fixed signing/upload activation
and actual production operations still require exact independent/owner approval.
Apple processing and actual TestFlight availability/installability remain unverified.

82 focused checks passed:54 new output/qualification/template/quota checks +28 affected
composition, downstream and reader checks. Real ZIP/hash/filesystem parsers ran;
HTTP, protected tools and credentials were mocked. Successful 57/59 suites and
APFS/native/encryption qualifications were not rerun wholesale. No live token,
credential transfer, native dispatch, signing/upload, Render change or spending.

Public API quota defect corrected: the former five full historical proof checks
alone exceeded GitHub's anonymous60/hour budget. A process-local exact-request
session verifies completed historical job/review facts fully once, then rechecks
actual run identity/success/deletion/rerun/expiry before each later phase. Every
LIVE current release/environment gate is still checked uncached. Only immutable
public workflow file bodies are shared within the initial proof batch; hashes
are always verified. Exact request or cached-proof mutation refuses. The full
signer path is bounded to60 public REST reads (59 for one reader commit); bootstrap requires53 remaining
reads before materializing the private SSH key. Missing quota headers refuse;
shared-IP rate changes still fail closed, with no retries or permission expansion.

Separate CI fixture correction f56984d302e66f91c7a603b1206635ec0002b979 passed
five affected offline checks and BOTH actual automatic policy-check runs
44927626073/44927621066. Native simulator/device jobs remained skipped. It fixes
only dummy launcher fixture/history retrieval, not an active workflow or source.
Account-specific billing observations are retained only in private Mission Control.
Fresh included-credit and storage checks remain mandatory before native dispatch.
No native dispatch or additional paid spending is authorized.
